players.product: GPU cloud capacity: usage allocations on NVIDIA GPU servers in the AI data centres it operates

quarterly_data.signal: First half of the fiscal year ending March 2026 (April-September 2025; semi-annual report): net sales JPY 1,746 million (+28.5% year on year), as existing businesses were steady and AI data-center service provision started in September 2025; operating loss JPY 1,370 million (prior-year period: loss of JPY 167 million) and adjusted EBITDA minus JPY 784 million, on heavy up-front investment costs for the AI data-center business; net loss attributable to owners of the parent JPY 1,465 million. Cost of sales JPY 1,276 million (+64.7%), including server usage fees of JPY 338 million; SG&A JPY 1,840 million (+144.8%). Domestic segment external sales JPY 1,198 million (+46.4%); Overseas segment external sales JPY 547 million (+1.4%) and segment profit JPY 90 million (+7.9%).
quarterly_data.figure: Net sales JPY 1,746 million (+28.5%); operating loss JPY 1,370 million; adjusted EBITDA minus JPY 784 million

quarterly_data.signal: AI data center project No. 1 (semi-annual report): on 07-10-2025 the company signed its first large AI data-center service-use contract indirectly, through its business partner NowNow Japan Co., Ltd., with a customer that is one of the world's largest cloud service providers; before that, on 07-04-2025, it signed the GPU server purchase agreement with its business partner GIGA COMPUTING CO., LTD. for this project's data center. The AI data-center business it describes covers the TAIZA AI cloud stack, an AI data-center platform, data-center operation, data-center investment and sales of GPUs for AI.
quarterly_data.figure: Contract signed 07-10-2025; GPU server agreement signed 07-04-2025

quarterly_data.signal: The company states the planned capital alliance making CUDO Ventures Ltd. (CUDO Compute) a subsidiary aims to integrate the two companies' AI data-center businesses: it is a precondition for CUDO to procure, for its services, the NVIDIA GPUs Datasection secures through its partner Taiwanese server suppliers that CUDO be a Datasection subsidiary.
